name: shell-width-alignment
title: Shell width alignment: content container and toast overlay do not follow the Liquefy navbar/footer panel geometry
description: After the React upgrade the default theme is Liquefy, whose navbar/footer are floating panels (inset 0.6rem, max-width 1320px, centered). The main content still uses the Bootstrap container-xxl breakpoints and the toast overlay is still pinned to the viewport edge, so their edges never line up with the panels.
creator: Xavior
